feedback.finish: Diwali is the Hindu festival of lights. It is celebrated by giving presents and decorating houses with bright lights, as well as setting off fireworks and lighting candles.

feedback.finish: Hanukkah is the Jewish holiday of lights. It is celebrated by lighting a special candleholder called a menorah, playing games, eating food and giving gifts.

finish.text: Eid is a Muslim holiday that celebrates the end of Ramadan, a holy month when Muslims don’t eat or drink from sunrise to sunset. Muslims celebrate by giving to charity, spending time with family and giving gifts.
